title: PERSPECTRA: A SCALABLE AND CONFIGURABLE PLURALIST BENCHMARK OF PERSPECTIVES FROM ARGUMENTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'pluralism'—the ability of LLMs to represent and distinguish between diverse viewpoints. While the topics used for evaluation often involve value judgments (e.g., healthcare as a right), the benchmark evaluates the model's structural and logical capacity to identify and separate different perspectives (through tasks like counting, matching, and polarity detection) rather than evaluating the moral, ethical, or religious content itself.
